title: Nullified Shield
description: Fixes Ricardo-OP-Art's Inventory Shield - Endmir26 resource pack so it works properly in version 26.1.x.
body:
This pack changes the view of the shield from the inventory and the Hot bar, fitting the 2D style, being different in hand, like the Spyglass and the Trident.

Unfortunately, the banner patterns of a shield are not visible in 2D mode, but in hand view it remains the same.

Originally made by [Ricardo-OP-Art](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/inventory-shield-endmir26).
